title: Smoke on the Horizon
summary: Expedition to Hearthsmoke Vale, the Vell's heartland (E4, E5). Meet the Vell, visit the Marro at the stone circle, and earn their trust or read the burned field (sky-fire).

objectives.text: Follow the smoke into the vale
Earn the Vell's trust, or find what burned in the south-east

rewards.text: The Vell's heartland is mapped. Their runners know the way to Touchdown now.
